about_the_game:
Fight, loot, and explore procedurally generated forests—alone or with friends in splitscreen or online co-op! Choose from four distinct classes—Archer, Bomber, Spartan, and Wizard—uncover powerful weapons with unique abilities, and build the ultimate deck of modifier cards. Can you survive the forest and defeat the cursed tree?

Archer, Bomber, Spartan, or Wizard—pick your playstyle!

Each class comes with unique items and abilities. Fire arrows and swing across gaps with the Archer’s grappling hook. Cause chaos with the Bomber’s explosive arsenal. Dominate melee combat as the Spartan. Or harness powerful spells as the Wizard. Each class has its own loot, and every weapon you find grants a unique special ability!

A new adventure every time you play

With procedurally generated levels full of unique challenges and rewards, every run features new loot and surprises. The game includes permadeath, so be careful. You keep the cards you collect along the way—build the best deck or go wild and create something crazy for fun. At the end of each level, a mini-boss awaits. Defeat all the levels, face the final boss, and win the game. Afterward, continue in infinite mode to chase the high score!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: 64-bit quad-core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for online multiplayer.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: 64-bit quad-core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with full Vulkan 1.2 support and 4GB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for online multiplayer.
